task.title: Finalize local Ollama/OpenCode autonomous factory
task.diagnostic: Le runner local est l'architecture cible. Le cloud workflow ne doit pas devenir une seconde implementation loop. Valider et durcir le chemin local PC allumé -> Ollama -> OpenCode -> queue AUTOPILOT -> tests -> PR.
evidence: Repository already contains local factory runner and shared .ai contracts.
Founder requires zero external LLM API keys and no concurrent cloud implementation loop.
implementation: Treat local Ollama/OpenCode as the sole implementation runner.
Ensure startup/recovery is deterministic when Windows boots and the runner is restarted.
Ensure the runner can consume AUTOPILOT issues without manual prompt copy/paste.
Ensure Ollama is detected locally and failure is explicit/recoverable.
Prevent the cloud workflow from creating a competing implementation loop; disable/remove it if it conflicts with the local architecture.
Keep GitHub Actions for CI/CD and verification only where appropriate.
Do not add Anthropic/OpenAI credentials or external LLM dependencies.
tests: Run a deterministic dry-run/local-agent availability check.
Verify an AUTOPILOT issue can enter the local queue without manual copy/paste.
acceptance: PC on + local runner started once is sufficient for continuous autonomous cycles.
No Anthropic/OpenAI API key is required.
No second cloud implementation agent can compete with the local runner.
A queued AUTOPILOT task is automatically consumed by the local runner.
Failures park/retry cleanly instead of deadlocking.
task.metric: zero manual prompt handoffs; zero concurrent implementation runners
task.rollback: Revert only the factory orchestration changes; preserve product code.
constraints: Do not delete the local factory.
Do not introduce a paid external LLM dependency.
task.stopCondition: Stop if Ollama is unavailable, credentials are unexpectedly required, or existing factory tests fail; report the blocker instead of bypassing it.

task.title: Stop GP domain serving indexable Martinique content
task.diagnostic: Production/SEO evidence shows multiple URLs on sargasses-guadeloupe.com serving Martinique-owned content. This conflicts with the existing multisite domain-isolation contract and risks geographic content pollution, duplicate/cross-domain indexing, and incorrect search landing pages.
task.evidence: LIVE evidence observed on 2026-09-30: /plages/pointe-faula/ identifies Pointe Faula, Le Vauclin, Martinique; /plages/anse-madame/ identifies Anse Madame, Schoelcher, Martinique; /conditions/plages-enfants/ is explicitly a Martinique page; /conditions/baignade-ideale/ is explicitly a Martinique page. Control evidence: genuine GP beach pages such as Caravelle and Pointe de la Verdure correctly identify Guadeloupe. Repository contracts already include region filtering/cross-domain duplicate prevention in scripts/prepare-ftp.cjs and sitemap cross-domain checks in scripts/automation/seo-sitemap-check.cjs.
filesToModify: Only the minimal producer/packaging/deploy-contract files proven by diagnosis
implementation: Trace why Martinique-owned beach/conditions pages remain publicly reachable on the GP domain despite existing region filtering and cross-domain-drop logic.
Determine whether the root cause is generated HTML, GP mirror/overlay, packaging, stale deployment artifact, Cloudflare edge/cache propagation, or incomplete cross-domain filtering.
Fix the producer/packaging path so GP-owned indexable output cannot contain MQ-only pages.
Do not use blanket noindex as a substitute when a page should not exist on the GP domain.
Preserve legitimate Guadeloupe pages and intentional cross-domain links/canonicals.
Ensure sitemap generation/checks reject GP URLs whose content contract is MQ-owned.
Add regression coverage for representative MQ-only pages and representative GP pages.
Verify generated artifacts and, when deploy access is available, verify live production output after deployment.
tests: Regression: MQ-only pages absent from GP indexable output
Regression: representative GP pages remain present
Production post-deploy HTTP/content verification when deployment occurs
acceptance: sargasses-guadeloupe.com must not serve an indexable Martinique-owned beach/conditions page as GP content.
Pointe Faula and Anse Madame must be absent from GP indexable output or handled by the established intentional redirect/canonical contract.
Representative GP pages remain available and correctly identify Guadeloupe.
GP sitemap contains only valid GP-owned indexable URLs plus explicitly documented exceptions.
No cross-domain duplicate pollution is reintroduced.
task.metric: Count of MQ-owned indexable URLs served on sargasses-guadeloupe.com; target = 0.
task.rollback: Revert the isolated domain-isolation commit if production verification shows unintended GP route loss; restore the previously valid sitemap/domain contract.
constraints: Local factory is the sole implementation runner.
Do not launch a parallel implementation loop.
Do not change pricing, payment, checkout, webhook, grants, Supabase schema, or secrets.
Distinguish generator correctness from live edge/cache correctness.
If the actual root cause is Cloudflare cache/routing and requires an unavailable permission, stop with the exact operational action needed rather than masking the defect.
task.stopCondition: Stop and report if diagnosis proves the remaining blocker requires an unavailable Cloudflare/GSC/DNS production permission or would require broad unrelated refactoring.

beforeAfter.after: GP domain exposes only GP-owned indexable content for these surfaces; representative GP pages remain intact.

task.title: CTA annuel B2B invisible : exposer `reachable` + `value` sur le catalogue de paylinks servi
task.diagnostic: Le guard `reachable !== true` de selectB2bPaylink() (app) et de urlFromCatalog() (emails B2B) n était satisfait par AUCUN écrivain du dépôt. La worker publiait {url, amount, currency} seuls → le CTA annuel B2B ne s affichait jamais. Le catalogue statique était intégralement mort (404) et aucune alerte ne le signalait.
evidence: LIVE 2026-11-26 : GET /api/b2b-paylinks.json (worker sg-payments) renvoyait {url, amount, currency} SEULS — sans `reachable`, sans `value`.
selectB2bPaylink() (src/lib/b2b-paylink-offer.mjs:11, garde fa5f37f26) exige `link.reachable === true` → null en permanence.
Aucun écrivain du drapeau `reachable` dans tout le dépôt (git -S reachable sur le JSON statique = 0 occurrence).
LIVE : GET /api/mollie-pay?plan=pro_annual → 200 ; pro_annual_usd → 200 ; brief_annual / brief_annual_usd / territory_annual → 404 (hors B2B_PLANS).
Les 10 URL de public/api/b2b-paylinks.json → 404 : même garde côté emails B2B (scripts/automation/lib/b2b-paylinks.cjs:21) sur un catalogue mort.
Entonnoir 28 j (Apps Script ?action=funnel) : 21 875 session_starts → 1 159 ouvertures modal → 4 CTA → 4 checkout_redirect → 0 onsite_checkout_opened → 0 payment_paid.
Revenu réel (daily-metrics.json) : 69,86 € MRR / 14 abonnés Stripe ; 0 nouveau paiement Stripe sur 30 j ; mollie.paid = {} ; b2b = 0.
implementation: Exposer `value` (miroir exact de `amount`) + `reachable: true` sur les deux seuls tiers à page de paiement prouvée vivante (pro_annual 690 EUR, pro_annual_usd 790 USD).
Garder `Cache-Control: no-store` (pas de catalogue figé).
Ajouter une passe de vérification live SANS clé API qui écrit `reachable` + `verifiedAt` à chaque run du générateur.
Restreindre l auto-réparation aux 5 tiers annuels B2B (même montant, même label).
Vérifier-seulement les entrées B2C (grille périmée 4,99/12,99/19,99 vs offre validée 2026-11-09 à 7,99/14,99/24,99).
Verrouiller le contrat par un nouveau test worker + corriger le test qui imposait l état tout-mort.
tests: npm run build → exit 0 (136 pages plage)
run locale du générateur : 10 URL sondées, drapeaux écrits, `Invalid Authorization header` attendu (aucune création sans clé)
acceptance: selectB2bPaylink(catalog, "pro", false) renvoie une URL + un montant depuis le catalogue SERVI par la worker.
Aucun lien marqué `reachable: true` qui répond 404.
Aucun prix changé : `value` reste le miroir de `amount`.
Les tiers sans page de paiement vivante restent absents du catalogue.
task.metric: Part des sessions B2B avec un CTA annuel rendu (avant : 0). La mesure elle-même est cassée — daily-metrics.json figé depuis 2026-08-03 et analytics_events illisible en lecture anon.
constraints: Ne JAMAIS recreer les liens B2C (grille perimee) — cela minterait un prix non valide.
Ne changer AUCUN montant, aucune grille d offre, aucun webhook, aucun grant.
Ne jamais compter un paiement TEST comme une vente.
Pas de deploiement sans validation explicite sur le SHA exact.
Aucun secret en Git ni dans les logs.
task.stopCondition: Stop si un correctif exige de changer un prix ou de merger/deployer sans decision fondateur.

beforeAfter.before: Catalogue servi = {url, amount, currency} seuls → selectB2bPaylink() → null → CTA annuel jamais affiché.
beforeAfter.after: Catalogue servi = {url, amount, currency, value, reachable: true} → CTA annuel 690 € / 790 $ rendu ; vérification live à chaque run.
